meta.name: competitor-pages
meta.description: Competitor page gap analysis — take a query you want to win and the pages currently outranking you, and produce a concrete brief on what to add or change to compete. Compares content depth and coverage (subtopics they cover that you don't), structure (headings, format, tables, media), search-intent match, E-E-A-T signals, schema/rich-result eligibility, internal linking, and on-page optimization — across your page vs. the top-ranking competitors. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know why a competitor outranks them on a specific query, what a top-ranking page does better, a content-gap analysis against specific competitor URLs, or a brief to beat a specific SERP. Trigger on: "why does competitor X outrank me", "content gap analysis", "competitor page analysis", "what does the top result have that I don't", "how do I beat this page", "analyze competitor pages", "SERP gap", "compete for [keyword]". For seed keyword discovery use /keyword-research; for a content calendar use /content-planner.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞争对手页面，生成内容优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道为什么竞争对手排名更高，以及如何改进自己的页面。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitor pages and generate content improvement briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know why competitors outrank you and how to improve your page.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 SEO 分析师：提供关键词、你的页面和 1-3 个竞争对手页面，它会抓取对比，找出内容覆盖、结构、搜索意图、E-E-A-T、schema、内部链接等差距，并生成一份改进简报。
howto.when: 当用户说出「为什么竞争对手比我排名高」「内容差距分析」「分析竞争对手页面」等类似请求，或给出一个想竞争的关键词和竞争对手页面链接时触发；若只给关键词，它会先询问比较对象。

say.text: 为什么我的竞争对手在这个关键词上排名比我高？
say.note: 它会抓取双方页面并给出差距清单。

say.text: 这是我的页面和两个竞争对手的 URL，帮我做内容差距分析。
say.note: 它会输出覆盖矩阵和缺失子主题。

say.text: 给我一份打败这个搜索结果页的改进简报。
say.note: 简报可直接交给内容编辑。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into an SEO analyst: with a keyword and competitor URLs, it compares your page against theirs (coverage, structure, intent, E-E-A-T, schema, links) and produces a brief on what to add or change to compete.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks why a competitor outranks them, requests content gap analysis, or gives a query and competitor URLs for a SERP-beating brief. With only a query, it asks for competitors.

say_en.text: Why does my competitor outrank me for this keyword?
say_en.note: It crawls both pages and lists the gaps.

say_en.text: Here are my page and two competitor URLs; do a content gap analysis.
say_en.note: It returns a coverage matrix and missing subtopics.

say_en.text: Give me a brief to beat this SERP for this query.
say_en.note: The brief is ready to hand to content writers.
